title: Ratios, rates and proportions: cheat sheet

blocks.title: The big idea
blocks.body: A ratio compares two amounts. A rate compares amounts with different units. A proportion says two ratios are equal, so you can scale one to find a missing number.

blocks.title: Ratios
items: Order matters: boys to girls is not girls to boys
Simplify by dividing both parts by their GCF
Add the parts to get the whole
Share by finding the size of one part

blocks.title: Unit rate
blocks.body: $\text{unit rate}=\dfrac{\text{amount}}{\text{number of units}}$, such as miles $\div$ hours
Put the same quantity on top on both sides of a proportion, and divide by the old value for percent change.
